author: (Melvill, 1927)

note.en: A small turrid of the western Caribbean known here from one 1929 museum record (listed as San Blas), so it is only a record.
note.es: Un turrido pequeño del Caribe occidental conocido aquí por un registro de museo de 1929 (rotulado San Blas), así que es solo un registro.

evidence: OBIS: 1 record in the region box

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
